customManagers.description: Tool versions marked with a `# renovate:` comment on the line above.

packageRules.description: CI and dev tools ship nothing: one chore PR a month, no release.
SwiftLint and actionlint are checked against a sha256 Renovate can't compute.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Update `swiftlint_sha256` / `actionlint_sha256` in `.github/actions/setup/action.yml`: `curl -fsSL <download URL> | shasum -a 256`. CI fails until then.

packageRules.description: Sparkle ships inside the app: its own PR right away, as a fix, so merging releases it.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Renovate doesn't update `Package.resolved`: run `swift package resolve` and commit it to this branch.
